what: A stack of cards piled in one spot — only the top one is straight and the rest are staggered at −7.5·6.8·−5.5·8.2·−8.5·6.2·−7·7.8°. Pressing the upper half of the panel straightens the next card in .35s while the top card flies up 140% and tilts ±9° more (.38s power2.inOut), goes to the back and settles at its own angle (.38s power2.out). The lower half works in reverse — the back card drops out 120% below and then rises to stand on top. Side ticks: only the chosen one is 34px · clear, the others 14px · .35. On mouse, a round arrow follows the cursor in .15s and flips in .25s depending on the upper or lower half.

options.[data-fx-part=ticks]: Empty slot to fill the ticks (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=cursor]: Arrow that follows the cursor (optional, hidden on touch screens)
options.settle: Time for the next card to straighten (s), default .35
options.fly: Distance flying upward (% of card height), default 140 — downward is .857 times that
